title: Interface Definitions
description: Definitions of properties, terminals, parameters, and telemetry common to DSP algorithms and firmware modules.

allOf.title: Property
allOf.description: A static configuration property that specifies an aspect of an object that doesn't change while it is running.

name.title: Property Name
name.description: The name of the property, which must be unique among all properties, terminals, parameters, and telemetry in the same interface.

property_setting.title: Property Setting
property_setting.description: A specification for a property setting in a static configuration.

name.title: Property Name
name.description: The name of the property whose value is configured by this setting.

value.title: Property Value
value.description: The value to set for the property in this configuration.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: A set of input or output channels through which an algorithm sends or receives signals.

name.title: Terminal Name
name.description: The name of the terminal, which must be unique among all properties, terminals, parameters, and telemetry for the same algorithm.

signal_type.title: Terminal Signal Type
signal_type.description: The name of the type of signal used by this terminal.

direction.title: Terminal Direction
direction.description: Specifies whether this is an input ("in") or output ("out") terminal.

channels.title: Number of Channels in Terminal
channels.description: Specifies the number of channels in the terminal, either as a constant integer value, or a property whose value determines the number of channels.

minimum_channels.title: Minimum Channels in Terminal
minimum_channels.description: Specifies the minimum number of channels in the terminal that can be specified in the static configuration.

maximum_channels.title: Maximum Channels in Terminal
maximum_channels.description: Specifies the maximum number of channels in the terminal that can be specified in the static configuration.

bypass_source.title: Source Terminal for Bypass
bypass_source.description: The name of the input terminal from this algorithm to be copied to this output terminal when bypass is enabled.

terminal_channels.title: Terminal Channels
terminal_channels.description: A specification for the number of channels in a terminal in a static configuration.

name.title: Terminal Name
name.description: The name of the terminal whose number of channels is configured by this setting.

channels.title: Number of Channels
channels.description: The number of channels to set for the terminal in this configuration.

block_connection.title: Block Connection
block_connection.description: A specification for a signal connection between two blocks in the same task in a static configuration.

source_block.title: Source Block Name
source_block.description: The name of the block within this task that is generating the signal to connect.

output_terminal.title: Output Terminal Name
output_terminal.description: The name of the terminal in the source block that is generating the signal to connect.

output_channel.title: Output Channel Index
output_channel.description: The index (1-based) of the channel in the output terminal to connect.

destination_block.title: Destination Block Name
destination_block.description: The name of the block within this task that is receiving the signal.

input_terminal.title: Input Terminal Name
input_terminal.description: The name of the terminal in the destination block that is receiving the signal.

input_channel.title: Input Channel Index
input_channel.description: The index (1-based) of the channel in the input terminal to connect.

allOf.title: Parameter
allOf.description: A dynamic user paramater that can be modified at any time while the algorithm is running.

name.title: Parameter Name
name.description: The name of the parameter, which must be unique among all properties, terminals, parameters, and telemetry for the same algorithm.

parameter_setting.title: Parameter Setting
parameter_setting.description: A setting for the value of a dynamic parameter.

target.title: Parameter Target
target.description: The name of the block or module that owns the parameter to change.

name.title: Parameter Name
name.description: The name of the parameter to update.

value.title: Parameter Value
value.description: The value to set for the parameter.

allOf.title: Telemetry
allOf.description: A dynamic meter that reports some aspect of the algorithm's state while it is running.

name.title: Telemetry Name
name.description: The name of the telemetry, which must be unique among all properties, terminals, parameters, and telemetry for the same algorithm.

telemetry_type.title: Telemetry Type
telemetry_type.description: The type of telemetry generated (periodic meters, or asynchronous events).

period_type.title: Telemetry Period Type
period_type.description: For periodic meters, specifies whether the frequency and priority of the telemetry.

task_connection.title: Task Connection
task_connection.description: A specification for a signal connection between two tasks in the same device in a static configuration.

source_task.title: Source Task Name
source_task.description: The name of the task within this device that is generating the signal to connect.

output_block.title: Output Block Name
output_block.description: The name of the block in the source task that is generating the signal to connect.

output_channel.title: Output Channel Index
output_channel.description: The index (1-based) of the channel in the output block to connect.

destination_task.title: Destination Task Name
destination_task.description: The name of the task within this device that is receiving the signal.

input_block.title: Input Block Name
input_block.description: The name of the block in the destination task that is receiving the signal.

input_channel.title: Input Channel Index
input_channel.description: The index (1-based) of the channel in the input block to connect.

version.title: Version String
version.description: A version string, compliant with semantic versioning (https://semver.org).

dimensions.title: Dimensions of a Parameter or Telemetry
dimensions.description: The dimensions of a parameter or telemetry, specified either by an integer or the name of a property or terminal whose value or channel count determines the dimensions.

value_spec.title: Value Specification
value_spec.description: A specification of the type and constraints on a value for a property, parameter, or telemetry.

value_type.title: The Type of Data Stored in the Value

maximum_length.title: Maximum Length for a String Property Value

allowed_values.title: List of Allowed Values for String or Numerical Types
